name: Default private generation interview
description: Private planning questions used before full character generation when the active template does not define its own Interview / Q&A section.

questions.label: Core Identity
questions.question: What is the most important identity, role, premise, or defining fact that must remain true about this character?

questions.label: Primary Motivation
questions.question: What does the character want most at the start of the roleplay, and what makes that desire personally important?

questions.label: Inner Conflict
questions.question: What contradiction, insecurity, unresolved tension, or competing desire gives the character emotional depth?

questions.label: Dynamic with {{user}}
questions.question: What relationship or interpersonal dynamic should exist between {{char}} and {{user}}, including trust, tension, expectations, affection, rivalry, dependence, or uncertainty implied by the concept?

questions.label: Boundaries
questions.question: What important limits, refusals, fears, sensitivities, or lines the character is reluctant to cross should shape their behaviour?

questions.label: Voice
questions.question: How should {{char}} sound in dialogue: tone, vocabulary, pacing, slang, formality, verbal habits, and any distinctive quirks?

questions.label: Visual Anchor
questions.question: Which physical appearance, outfit, accessory, or presentation details are most important to preserve consistently?

questions.label: Opening Hook
questions.question: What immediate situation, tension, goal, or interaction should the Scenario and First Message begin with so the roleplay is playable straight away?

questions.label: Private Complication
questions.question: Is there a secret, misconception, hidden pressure, or complication that would make the character more interesting without contradicting the supplied concept?
